text_summary.body: One who sends an exactor through the glory of the kingdom is destroyed within a few days, not in anger or battle; in his place a contemptible person arises.

setting.body: Seleucus IV, son of Antiochus III, reigned 12 years (BM 35603) and was killed in a conspiracy of Heliodorus (Appian, Syr. 45); Antiochus IV, his brother, was installed with the help of Eumenes and Attalus. The king list records Seleucus's death and Antiochus's accession in Ululu 137 SE.

not_applicable.commentary: Interpretive commentary is recorded on the Daniel 11 prophecy records.
not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: No competing reconstruction of the event itself found in the sources read.
